posts.t: Roman Kantserov has been one of the few bright spots for the Blackhawks through 17 games. @marklazerus.bsky.social on the adjustments Kantserov's making on and off the ice: www.nytimes.com/athletic/775...

Amid all the justifiable negativity surrounding the Blackhawks right now, there is one very big bright spot:

Roman Kantserov is gonna be a star. On and off the ice. 

Mini-feature plus five game observations from Tampa:
www.nytimes.com/athletic/775...
Roman Kantserov fires the Blackhawks' first shot of the game at about the 8:30 mark.

Connor Bedard doesn't want to hear excuses and big-picture perspectives. Because it was the Blackhawks themselves, not the rest of us, who raised the bar for this season. 

"WE all said we think we’re going to win this year. WE set the expectations on ourselves."

www.nytimes.com/athletic/775...

NEW POWERS & LAZ: @marklazerus.bsky.social and I discuss what's possibly at stake for the Blackhawks and Jeff Blashill on this road trip. 

Listen here: www.patreon.com/PowersandLaz...

If this brutal road trip goes badly, the Blackhawks could face a reckoning next week.

The four-day break would be a logical time for Kyle Davidson to make changes, if he's going to.

New column: chicago.suntimes.com/blackhawks/2...
Patrick Kane will miss the next couple games with an upper-body injury
Avalanche defeat the Blackhawks, 5-2. Blackhawks fall to 4-10-1 on the season.
Not a ton of 5v5 ice time for Frondell tonight. Only Teräväinen and Cole Smith have played less than him.
Patrick Kane will not return to the game.
Blackhawks with a crowd of 17,838 at the United Center tonight. They came into the game averaging 17,926.
Rough night for the Blackhawks fourth line, especially Ryan Greene. With Greene on the ice, the Avalanche have a 14-0 advantage in shot attempts, 7-0 in shots on goal and 2-0 in goals.
Patrick Kane doesn't appear to be on the Blackhawks' bench.
Blackhawks to the power play. They're for 0 for 2 so far today.
Bedard takes the Blackhawks' sixth penalty. Avalanche back to the power play.
Blackhawks with their fifth penalty of the game as Rinzel heads to the box for holding.
Bedard, Kane and Bertuzzi on the ice now.
Blackhawks have put together a few different combos on offensive zone faceoffs this period. Bedard joining Frondell and Bertuzzi on this shift.
The Blackhawks and Avalanche are tied 2-2 after one period. Avalanche up 13-4 in shots on goal.
The Blackhawks are 3 for 3 on challenges this season, according to Scouting the Refs.
